# CodePerfect

> AI Career Compass & Private Skill Matcher

## Overview
CodePerfect (KYC) is a privacy-first career intelligence platform. All AI processing runs 100% locally in your browser using Transformers.js — no data ever leaves the device.

## Features
- **On-Device Skill Matching**: Upload your resume (PDF) or connect GitHub to extract skills, then match against engineering roles using cosine similarity on local WASM embeddings.
- **AI Career Roadmap**: Generate personalized learning paths for missing skills using the Gemini API.
- **Voice Interview Studio**: Practice technical interviews with AI-generated questions and real-time speech recognition.
- **Spatial Dashboard**: Visualize your career trajectory with radar charts, salary projections, and enterprise compatibility scores.
